observations.content: Verified the fix/cache-race-condition branch: all 14 tests pass (10 unit + 4 concurrency). The CacheStore implementation uses per-key mutex locking via a KeyLock class, version stamping on every entry, and provides three write strategies (set, setIfVersion, update) to prevent the stale-read-overwrite race condition.
No git remote is configured on this local repo, so a PR cannot be opened until a remote (e.g. GitHub origin) is added. The branch fix/cache-race-condition is ready to push: 2 commits ahead of master.

The test infrastructure uses npx tsx with a hand-rolled test/assert pattern (no framework like Jest or Vitest). Tests are run via 'npx tsx src/__tests__/cache.test.ts'. The package.json 'test' script is already wired to this.

Did not re-implement the fix since the prior session's implementation is correct and complete. Verified by running the full test suite — all concurrency tests (50 parallel increments, competing setIfVersion, concurrent set+update, independent key parallelism) pass consistently.
